statement: The TLC model report writer (scripts/model-tlc.js, the only writer of TLC *.model.report.json and of the tracked evidence copies under architecture/contracts/evidence) renders byte-identical report JSON for an unchanged model outcome: outputTail has one owner (scripts/model-tlc-output-tail.js) that renders the TLC_NO_ERROR_VERDICT sentinel for a converged run and, for a non-converged run, at most TLC_OUTPUT_TAIL_LINE_LIMIT run-independent lines free of wall-clock stamps, fingerprint seeds, pids, absolute paths and trace-exploration file names, so npm run model:contracts leaves a clean checkout clean and the 0.2 release-gate receipt can record treeCleanAtFinish true; verdict derivation and the pass/fail semantics of model:tlc are unchanged and every registered config still meets its declared expectation. Proven deterministically over recorded TLC output and by two consecutive real model:contracts runs: red on HEAD (tails differ; the tracked route report is rewritten), green after.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
outputTail has exactly one owner (scripts/model-tlc-output-tail.js); scripts/model-tlc.js remains the only writer of TLC *.model.report.json and of the evidence copies.

For an unchanged model outcome two TLC runs render byte-identical report JSON; a converged report's tail is the TLC_NO_ERROR_VERDICT sentinel, a non-converged tail is bounded by TLC_OUTPUT_TAIL_LINE_LIMIT and free of stamps, seeds, pids, absolute paths and trace file names.

Verdict derivation (converged, temporalViolated, expectedFailureObserved, expectationMet) and the pass/fail exit semantics of model:tlc are unchanged; every registered config still meets its declared expectation; no src/ change.
Proof is a deterministic witness over recorded TLC output plus two real model:contracts runs leaving architecture/contracts/evidence clean; red on HEAD (tails differ, tree dirtied), green after.
